description: The dead zone, a map the earlier game had after Las, set down here as a further map of this game. Its numbers are those of the earlier game's map of that name: a grid of 5 by 5 tiles with a random entrance, an air of 37 °C, three wolves, and a wolf attack with a chance of 0.015 a game minute once 90 game minutes have passed since the last one. It has no streak to hold; it is solved by three beaten wolf attacks. Its resources are those of Las — głębiej in this game. Not carried over: the fading of the mage's skills and the wear of sticks of the earlier game, which this game does not have; and the three wolves are one kind of attacker here, as in the wolf pack of Las.
